description: Retrieves group details by their name.

name.description: The name of the group to be retrieved.

examples.user_query: Can you get the details for the 'Sales Team' group?
examples.notes: This retrieves the details for the 'Sales Team' group, such as its members and permissions.

examples.user_query: I need information about the 'Admin' group in our system.
examples.notes: This fetches the details for the 'Admin' group, which is typically used for system administrators.

examples.user_query: What are the details for the 'Marketing' group?
examples.notes: This call retrieves the details for the 'Marketing' group, which might include users and their access levels.

description: Retrieves all users within a specific group by name.

examples.user_query: Who are the members of the 'Data Analysts' group?
examples.notes: This retrieves a list of all users who belong to the 'Data Analysts' group. Use this to audit group membership or manage access.

examples.user_query: List all users in the 'Admins' group.
examples.notes: This call fetches all users assigned to the 'Admins' group. Useful for verifying administrative access.

examples.user_query: Get the users in the 'Marketing Team' group.
examples.notes: This retrieves all users who are part of the 'Marketing Team' group. Ideal for reviewing team-specific access permissions.

description: Retrieves all groups and maps them with the users belonging to those

examples.user_query: Can you show me all the groups in the system and the users assigned to each group?
examples.notes: This call retrieves a complete mapping of all groups to their respective users, excluding system-wide groups like 'Everyone' and 'All users in system'.

examples.user_query: I need a list of all groups, even if they don't have any users, and the users assigned to each group.
examples.notes: Use this call to get a comprehensive list of groups, including empty ones, along with their associated users.

examples.user_query: Who are the users in each group, and how are admins grouped?
examples.notes: This call provides a mapping of groups to users, with admin roles grouped under 'Admins'. Useful for auditing group memberships and admin assignments.
